method: ⭐ THE COMBINED SINGLE-PASS METHOD, carried verbatim from measurement/fpu_ladder_prep/BAND_CLAIM.json. ⛔ Do NOT run a per-band full-tree `grep -rIl`: the measurement/ artefact tree is multi-GB and the owner stopped exactly that in the ladder's build.
(a) TRACKED files -> `git grep -I -n -E '168000000000|169000000000|170000000000'` (reads PACKED OBJECTS, not the working tree; near-zero filesystem IO).

(b) UNTRACKED files -> exactly ONE filesystem pass over `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` IN THE MAIN TREE. ⚠️ THIS HALF MUST BE RUN AGAINST THE MAIN TREE, NOT A WORKTREE: a git worktree has its own index and reports ZERO untracked files, so a sweep run from a worktree silently skips (b) entirely. That was observed and corrected during this build.
(c) CLASSIFY per band by reading only the (few) HIT FILES, never the tree again.

⭐ AND A BOUNDARY READING: a band id is an INTEGER DECK SEED, so a digit run that sits INSIDE A FLOAT MANTISSA or is glued to another digit can never be one. The classification pass reads one character either side of every hit.
